statement: Warren 2026-10-07 on the N0085_DESIGN.md questions: (1) every reporting customer's site is fetched, including Amazon product pages and Makro site search, regardless of their site terms or robots rules; Warren states the data is public product and price information and no privacy act applies; the site-terms risk is ASUS's commercial call. (2) Discovery basis: only products each customer has reported selling in its sell-through files (last 6 months); Incredible Connection and HiFi Corp follow the same rule (4 products while their reports are stopped). (3) CIP fetches with an ordinary browser user agent, not a CIP-identifying one. Engineering bounds kept by GOV-001: polite per-site spacing, a per-site pause on 403/429, a per-run time limit; no CAPTCHA solving, proxy/IP rotation or other bot-protection evasion; a site that blocks shows as paused on screen.
